# Fix corpus

A [permanently moved page](http://perm.example.com/old) is safe to rewrite.

A [temporarily moved page](http://temp.example.com/old) is not.

A [dead page](http://dead.example.com/gone) may have an archive snapshot.

The [setup guide](./guide/setup.md#install) moved to another directory.

A [healthy link](http://ok.example.com/) needs no proposal at all.
